mapper.select: SELECT id, ticket_code, initiation_id, warranty_id, title, description, category, priority, status, reporter_id, reporter_name, reporter_phone, assignee_id, assignee_name, accepted_at, started_at, resolved_at, closed_at, response_due_at, resolve_due_at, response_breached, resolve_breached, resolution_note, customer_score, customer_comment, file_ids, tenant_id, provider_trace_id, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, deleted FROM pmis_ops_ticket WHERE ticket_code = #{code} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT id, ticket_code, initiation_id, warranty_id, title, description, category, priority, status, reporter_id, reporter_name, reporter_phone, assignee_id, assignee_name, accepted_at, started_at, resolved_at, closed_at, response_due_at, resolve_due_at, response_breached, resolve_breached, resolution_note, customer_score, customer_comment, file_ids, tenant_id, provider_trace_id, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, deleted FROM pmis_ops_ticket WHERE initiation_id = #{initiationId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT id, ticket_code, initiation_id, warranty_id, title, description, category, priority, status, reporter_id, reporter_name, reporter_phone, assignee_id, assignee_name, accepted_at, started_at, resolved_at, closed_at, response_due_at, resolve_due_at, response_breached, resolve_breached, resolution_note, customer_score, customer_comment, file_ids, tenant_id, provider_trace_id, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, deleted FROM pmis_ops_ticket WHERE warranty_id = #{warrantyId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT id, ticket_code, initiation_id, warranty_id, title, description, category, priority, status, reporter_id, reporter_name, reporter_phone, assignee_id, assignee_name, accepted_at, started_at, resolved_at, closed_at, response_due_at, resolve_due_at, response_breached, resolve_breached, resolution_note, customer_score, customer_comment, file_ids, tenant_id, provider_trace_id, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, deleted FROM pmis_ops_ticket WHERE status IN ('OPEN', 'ASSIGNED', 'IN_PROGRESS') AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY response_due_at
mapper.update: UPDATE pmis_ops_ticket SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

UPDATE pmis_ops_ticket SET assignee_id = #{assigneeId}, assignee_name = #{assigneeName}, status = #{status}, accepted_at = #{acceptedAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE pmis_ops_ticket SET response_breached = TRUE, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE pmis_ops_ticket SET resolve_breached = TRUE, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT status, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM pmis_ops_ticket WHERE initiation_id = #{initiationId} AND deleted = 0 GROUP BY status

SELECT priority, SUM(CASE WHEN response_breached THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS response_breach_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN resolve_breached THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS resolve_breach_cnt, COUNT(1) AS total FROM pmis_ops_ticket WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY priority
